pairs.label: Has anyone on this policy, or any company director ever had insurance declined, cancelled, avoided or special terms imposed?
Has anyone on this policy, or any company director ever had a claim repudiated or refused?
Has anyone on this policy, or any company director been the subject of a County Court Judgement and/or ever been cited in any unsatisfiled court judgements (or the Scottish equivalent)

Has anyone on this policy, or any company director been the subject of an individual voluntary arrangement with creditors, voluntary liquidation, a winding up or administrative proceeding or declared bankrupt?
Has anyone on this policy, or any company director suffered a disability that has a requirement to contact the DVLA but which has not been reported to the DVLA?
Has anyone on this policy, or any company director been convicted of any criminal conviction not spent under the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act or have any prosecutions pending?
Has anyone on this policy, or any company director been a director or business partner of a business or company other than the motor trade business proposed here?
Has anyone on this policy, or any company director been involved in a vehicle rental, self drive hire, vehicle leasing, vehicle broking or accident claims management?
Has anyone on this policy, or any company director been disqualified from acting as a company director for any period of time?
Has anyone on this policy, or any company director been a director of a company that has gone into liquidation or dissolved within the last ten years?
